conflicts_and_limits: SLSA-derived illustration has separate Community Specification License attribution; no blanket MIT rights clearance.
Source says issued tokens cannot be organization-controlled, conflicting with its later scoped revocation recommendations.
Categorical outside-collaborator ban, groups-only access and two-employee-review preferences require explicit contextual policy decisions.
Several history/compromise sections repeat visibility-only mitigations; those do not independently prove force-push/deletion protection.
MFA wording must distinguish human login from supported automated credentials.
